Container.Name: typestash
Container.Overview: Self-hosted font library. Point it at a folder of fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2, TTC or zips) and get a searchable gallery with live previews, a type tester with variable-font axes and OpenType features, glyph maps, pairing, collections, compare, specimen sheets and one-click downloads.

Config.Name: Fonts
Config.Description: Your font folder (scanned recursively). Uploads are filed under Uploads/<Family>/.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns written files

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns written files

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on a login (user: typestash). Leave empty if you use a reverse proxy with its own auth.

Config.Name: Allow uploads
Config.Description: Set to false for a read-only library
